verdict.rationale: Datalab publishes a dedicated Version Policies page. It promises no breaking changes within top-level API versions and preserves existing input and output parameters across API, SDK, and on-prem container versions, with a linked changelog; agent processors can also be pinned as <id>@<version>. The evidence does not show an explicit deprecation policy with timelines or sunset notice, model-output changes are exempt, and version pinning is enterprise-only. missing for 10: an explicit documented deprecation/sunset timeline and notice process, version pinning outside enterprise plans, stability guarantees for model output, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
